# Peptide Plainly

> Friendly, plain-English explanations of peptide research, plus a free weekly newsletter. Every claim links to PubMed or official FDA/WADA sources. Education only, not medical advice. We never give doses for research-only peptides; for FDA-approved drugs we summarize the official label and note that the prescriber sets the dose.

## Start here
- [Peptides 101](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides-101.html): what peptides are, approved vs research-only, reading studies
- [Why is peptide info so confusing?](https://peptideplainly.com/why-peptide-info-is-confusing.html)
- [Glossary](https://peptideplainly.com/glossary.html)

## Peptide guides (why people are excited, quick facts, dosing & timing, evidence, FAQ)
- [Semaglutide (Ozempic, Wegovy, Rybelsus): benefits, results & how to take it](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/semaglutide.html): FDA-approved. What is semaglutide (Ozempic, Wegovy)? The plain-English guide: how it works, the big trial results, FDA label dosing, and FAQs.
- [Tirzepatide (Mounjaro, Zepbound): benefits, results & how to take it](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/tirzepatide.html): FDA-approved. What is tirzepatide (Mounjaro, Zepbound)? How it works, the trial that beat semaglutide, FDA label dosing, and FAQs.
- [Retatrutide: record-breaking Phase 3 results & what's next](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/retatrutide.html): Research purposes only (investigational). What is retatrutide? Plain-English guide to Lilly's triple-agonist weight-loss shot: up to −25% in Phase 3 TRIUMPH-1, status, and FAQs.
- [Orforglipron (Foundayo): the GLP-1 pill, results & how to take it](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/orforglipron.html): FDA-approved. What is orforglipron (Foundayo)? Plain-English guide to Lilly's daily GLP-1 weight-loss pill: FDA label dosing, trial results, and how it differs from Wegovy pills.
- [BPC-157: benefits, research & what people use it for](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/bpc-157.html): Research purposes only. What is BPC-157? The plain-English guide to the popular recovery peptide: what the research shows, status, and FAQs.
- [TB-500 (thymosin beta-4): benefits, research & what people use it for](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/tb-500.html): Research purposes only. What is TB-500? The plain-English guide to thymosin beta-4 and TB-500: what it is, the research, status, and FAQs.
- [GHK-Cu (copper peptide): skin benefits, research & how it's used](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/ghk-cu.html): Research purposes only (injectable). What is GHK-Cu, the copper peptide? Skincare benefits, what the research shows, status, and FAQs.
- [Collagen peptides: skin benefits, results & how to take them](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/collagen-peptides.html): Dietary supplement. Do collagen peptides work? What meta-analyses of 26 trials show for skin hydration, elasticity and wrinkles, plus FAQs.
- [Tesamorelin (Egrifta): belly-fat results, benefits & label dosing](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/tesamorelin.html): FDA-approved (HIV lipodystrophy only). What is tesamorelin (Egrifta)? Plain-English guide: how it cuts deep belly fat, FDA label dosing, the trial, and FAQs.
- [CJC-1295 & ipamorelin: the GH stack, benefits & research](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/cjc-1295-ipamorelin.html): Research purposes only. CJC-1295 and ipamorelin explained plainly: the popular GH stack, what studies found, status, and FAQs.
- [MOTS-c: the mitochondrial 'exercise' peptide, benefits & research](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/mots-c.html): Research purposes only. What is MOTS-c? Plain-English guide to the 'exercise in a vial' mitochondrial peptide: the research, status, and FAQs.
- [Semax: the nasal brain peptide, benefits & research](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/semax.html): Research purposes only. What is Semax? Plain-English guide to the nasal brain peptide: the research on BDNF and stroke recovery, status, and FAQs.
- [PT-141 (bremelanotide, Vyleesi): benefits, results & how to take it](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/pt-141.html): FDA-approved (as Vyleesi). What is PT-141 (bremelanotide, Vyleesi)? Plain-English guide: FDA label use and dosing, trial results, side effects, and how 'research PT-141' differs.
